audit_items.proof_trace: burn_ctokens computes redeem_collateral_amount = exchange_rate.int_mul(ctokens.value()), where int_mul performs floor((exchange_rate_decimal * ctokens) / WAD), yielding exactly floor(exchange_rate * ctokens). The exchange_rate is captured before decrease_ctoken_supply mutates total_supply, ensuring consistency; withdraw_underlying then returns exactly that integer amount. The only deviation from strict equality is ≤1 unit of truncation (integer floor), which always favors the protocol and is correct behavior for fixed-point integer arithmetic.
